title: release cutover checklist — daily scratchpad (2026-03-11)
content:
Daily scratchpad for cutover (notes to self)

High-level: ship 2026.03.11 release (runtime perf + canary routing fix). Target window: 09:00-12:00 PT. Primary goal: zero customer-impact; fallback plan ready.

People
- Lead: Kai Morgan (me)
- Flighting/canary owner: Aisha Patel
- Rollback owner + SRE oncall: Jordan Lee
- Notified: Eng PM (Maya), Prod Mgmt (Evan), CS oncall (Riley)
- Pager: SRE rotation (pagerduty) - ensure contact info is up to date

Pre-cutover (DAY BEFORE) - DONE/TO DO
- [x] Finalize PRs: merge PR #487 (inference-release) - merged 2026-03-10 16:12 PT
- [x] Tag release candidate: rc-2026.03.11-01
- [x] Build artifacts uploaded to internal registry (s3://redwood-inference/releases/2026.03.11)
- [ ] Run quick smoke on staging (small model) — Aisha to run at 08:00 PT
- [x] Notify affected teams in #release-cutover Slack (pinned message)
- [ ] Confirm dedicated capacity quotas for canary (dedicated pods: 4 GPU workers)

Cutover day schedule (09:00 PT start)
- 09:00 PT: pre-check (10m) - confirm canary config, infra healthy, alerts silenced except critical
- 09:10 PT: deploy canary to 10% traffic (route policy: latency first, fallback to cpu-quantized variant)
- 09:25 PT: monitor traces/latency/cost dashboard (Redwood Console - per-model)
- 09:35 PT: if no regressions -> ramp to 50%
- 09:55 PT: quick end-to-end test from internal prod account (chat + embedding paths)
- 10:10 PT: if OK -> ramp to 100% and close canary
- 10:20 PT: post-cutover checks, notify CS & PMs

Immediate checks after each step
- Error rate (5m window): < 0.5% increase vs baseline
- Median p95 latency: not worse than +20% over baseline
- Token cost/unit: within expected delta (watch for sudden spike)
- Logs: no obvious trace of OOM or model-serve errors (KV-cache mis-reads)

Backports / Hotfixes
- EXPECTED: backport runtime patch from PR #482 to legacy 1.3.x branch for on-prem customers (high priority)
- Tasks:
  - [ ] Cherry-pick commit abc123 -> release-1.3.x (Jordan)
  - [ ] Run unit + integration on on-prem test harness (2h)
  - [ ] Publish patch bundle and notify private-deployments customers (CS)

Comms checklist
- Pre-cutover: post reminder at 08:00 PT to #release-cutover and to affected customer threads
- Canary ramp-up: update every milestone (10% / 50% / 100%) with short note + perf snapshot
- Post-cutover: write short summary (bullets) and link to dashboards (Console links)
- Incident template ready in case of regression (use Confluence playbook link above)

Rollback plan (if severe regression)
- Rollback command (prod infra): infractl rollout undo --service inference-runtime --to-tag rc-2026.03.10 
- Steps:
  - Pause external traffic (route to fallback region)
  - Execute undo, verify pods are back to previous image
  - Re-open canary window later after fix
- Escalation: call SRE lead + offline war room if >30m impact or >2% error increase

Operational notes / runbook snippets (quick commands)
- Check current rollout: infractl rollout status --service inference-runtime --env prod
- Dump recent errors: kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-runtime --since=15m | grep ERROR | head -n 80
- Trigger warm cache: curl -X POST https://internal-redwood/fill-cache -d '{"prefetch":true}' (internal only)

Open questions / TODOs
- Confirm whether canary routing will fallback to cpu-quantized variant automatically (PR changed policy) — verify Aisha's test covers this
- Are Dedicated customers on different routing policy? Need to confirm that routing policy change doesn't affect reserved capacity behavior (ping infra team)
- Post-mortem owner assignment if we see perf regression after cutover

Notes to self (quick)
- Keep the Slack updates short: 1-2 lines + dashboard link
- If cost jumps, check batching and model variant quantization settings first
- Remember to export the timeline to Confluence after finalizing

Scratch misc (timestamps / commands logged during cutover)
- 2026-03-11 09:12 PT: canary deployed (image rc-2026.03.11-01)
- 2026-03-11 09:15 PT: minor spike in p95 for text-gen; traced to batching config mismatch on edge nodes (investigating)
- Quick mitigation: temporarily reduce max-batch-size for edge pool to 8 (command recorded in infra runbook)

End of scratchpad for now — update as we go.

---
Small reminders:
- Attach post-cutover notes to PR #487
- Send a short email to enterprise-customers@redwood (template in Confluence) if on-prem patch shipped
